data.body: RCA (proven): macOS default-suite lane selects -m 'platform_compat and not external'; that marker is applied only by tests/conftest.py at collection time. The Verified gate runs _build-and-test.yml from trusted main against the raw patchset tree (reusable-workflow ref binding), so a patchset predating the auto-marker collects 0 tests -> pytest exit 5 -> job fails. Discriminating experiment: current tree collects 909 (rc0); with the conftest auto-marker neutralized, 0 collected (rc5) — isolates the auto-marker as the necessary cause, ruling out strict-markers/invocation/integration tier. Origin: caused_by 3ba8-49d5-fee5-445d (commit 920492b1), class regression. Fix: tolerate rc5 -> success on the macOS cell ONLY; ubuntu still fails on rc5. RED->GREEN behavioural test executes the real lane shell (macOS->0, ubuntu->5), seen RED first. Replication: full gate run pending post-merge (fix only takes effect after merge, same ref-binding as A).
